items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: But I played once or twice with Buddy Petit's band. I sat in a band.

ctx.x: You never did play with Jack Perry then, I guess. Before he died, I guess quite a long time ago. I don't know who to play with Jack Perry. I was too young at the time, one of them.
But I played once or twice with Buddy Petit's band. I sat in a band. And I worked in...
Did you ever play with Chris Kelly?
